title: DEWP Signed Anchor Object
description: A signed commitment to a Daily Checkpoint Root AND its position in the log, published to an independent public anchor. The signature (or external attestation) covers the raw 32-byte anchorDigest = SHA-256(0x03 || JCS([dailyRoot,timestamp,issuer,algorithm,seqStart,seqEnd,chainHash])), never its hex encoding.

anyOf.description: SELF anchor: the DEWP §5.2 signature IS the evidence.
External anchor (REKOR / RFC3161): attestation lives in `evidence`; `signature` is empty.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ): the checkpoint's own commit time (its anchoredAt). An external witness's authenticated time is held against it (DEWP §5.3 time bound).

issuer.description: HTTPS URI or DID of the anchor provider.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm (signature scheme, not an encryption padding).

seqStart.description: First global seq the checkpoint commits (stringified integer). Part of the signed preimage: binds the anchor to one position in the log.

seqEnd.description: Last global seq the checkpoint commits (stringified integer). Part of the signed preimage.

chainHash.description: The checkpoint's §5.4 continuity chain hash, which commits to its range, entry count, commit time and every earlier root. Part of the signed preimage.

keyId.description: Identifier of the active SPKI public key used to verify `signature`.

signature.description: Base64 signature over the raw 32-byte anchorDigest. Empty for external anchors, whose attestation lives in `evidence` instead.

kind.description: SELF is the producer's own §5.2 signature; the rest are external issuers. Only external issuers count toward the §5.3 independence check, because a quorum made of one party's signatures is not a quorum.

evidence.description: Base64 self-contained attestation from an external issuer: a Rekor entry's SET plus inclusion proof, or a DER TimeStampToken. Null for SELF anchors, whose evidence IS `signature`. Carried in the bundle rather than fetched on demand so verification stays offline — a verifier that had to ask the anchor provider to confirm the anchor would be trusting it again.
